**Get Smart:**

- Because it is an Android device, it handles more operations on the terminal itself, such as menus, stock control and messages between kitchen and floor [4].
- It can replace a computer and a fiscal printer at the counter [3].
- Whether it prints the NF-e depends on the app you choose. Most apps available on the Get Smart issue NF-e [4].

- App subscriptions are charged by the app developers. Getnet charges rental and administrative fees [10].

**Get Clássica:**
- Its page (a 2025 page, which may be outdated) lists a free machine with a minimum of R$10,000 in sales, a free account and card, receiving in 2 days, and a single rate across the main card brands [5].
- The rates listed there are debit 1.69%, credit 1x 3.79%, 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96% and 5x 9.45% [5].

**Free-machine tiers on that page:**
- R$2k per month: Get Mini [5].
- R$10k per month: Get Mini or Get Clássica [5].
- R$60k per month: Get Mini, Get Clássica or Get Smart [5].

Antecipação lets you get the money from your credit sales before the normal settlement date. This covers both lump-sum (à vista) and installment sales, so you don't have to wait for the settlement period [6].

- **How to do it:** You can advance your sales in the Getnet Brasil app, which has no extra fees [9].
- **Timing:** A sale becomes available to advance from D+1, one business day after the sale. It stays available until D-3, three business days before the amount would be paid into your account [7]. For example, a sale made on 04/03 can be advanced from 05/03. If it would normally be credited on 03/04, it can be advanced until 31/03 [8].
- **Card brands:** For some brands, you can't advance through Getnet. You have to go to the brand's own operator [7].
- **Automatic advance:** This is a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" plan. It goes through credit approval, and Getnet assesses each contract individually [3].
- **Online store sales:** E-commerce sales stay blocked for advance for 6 months [5].

3. Run a communication test to check the chip's connectivity. Press the function button (F, # or the equivalent on your machine), choose option 2 (maintenance), then option 1 (communication test) [1][6].

Up to 48 installments with the crediário, but each card issuer sets its own installment limit under its credit policies [1][2][3]. Interest rates can also vary by issuer [1].

You can also print the simulation receipt if the machine has paper [2]. The simulation is only for reference. The issuer decides whether to approve the transaction when it is contracted [2].
